task: Add a system-resource status strip (CPU/RAM/VRAM sparklines) to the Activity page, consuming the new GET /api/system/resources route (see 2026-07-12T10-30-00Z-system-resources-route.json).

frontend/src/hooks/useSystemResourceSamp.summary: New hook. Polls api.fetchSystemResources() every 2000ms, keeps a rolling buffer capped at 30 samples (60s window) as SystemResourceSample[] ({t, cpuPct, ramUsedGB, ramTotalGB, vramUsedGB?, vramTotalGB?}), and derives hasVram: false only after 2 CONSECUTIVE polls come back missing vram fields (a single dropped sample does not flicker the row). Clears its interval on unmount. Returns {samples, hasVram}.

frontend/src/pages/Activity/components/S.summary: New card component mounted above QueueStats in ActivityPage's stats rail. Renders unconditionally (not gated on active jobs). Props: {samples, hasVram, loading?}. Renders a CPU row and a RAM row always; a VRAM row only when hasVram is true (omitted from the DOM entirely, not CSS-hidden). Each row: label span, inline <svg aria-hidden> sparkline (polyline + 'now' dot), right-aligned value span, and a visually-hidden (.sr-only) span with SR text. High-pressure state (pct >= 90 sustained for >= 2 consecutive samples, row-scoped) switches that row's dot/value color to var(--warning-text-strong). No aria-live region (2s-interval updates would spam SR announcements; deliberately distinct from SegmentRenderMonitor's milestone-only aria-live region).

frontend/src/pages/Activity/ActivityPage.summary: Mounts useSystemResourceSamples() and renders <SystemResourceStrip samples hasVram loading={samples.length === 0} /> as the first child of the stats panel, above <QueueStats />.

frontend/src/api/index.ts.summary: Added SystemResourcesResponse type and api.fetchSystemResources(): GET /api/system/resources, matching the backend route's {cpu_pct, ram_used_gb, ram_total_gb, vram_used_gb|null, vram_total_gb|null} shape exactly.

frontend/src/theme/components/activity.c.summary: Added .system-resource-strip* rules under a 'System resource strip' comment block, reusing existing var(--surface)/var(--border)/var(--radius-card)/var(--space-*)/var(--type-*) tokens only (no new hex/px literals) — verified via scripts/check_hardcoded_styles.py.

flow_impact: Activity page stats rail now has a live system-resource observability strip; no scheduler/orchestrator/watchdog code touched. New frontend->backend edge: ActivityPage (via useSystemResourceSamples) -> GET /api/system/resources (app/api/routers/system.py) -> app/engines/system_resources.sample_resources.
